description: One step of a TmOnboardingChecklist: what to do, how it is presented and — once the user worked through it — whether it is done. The checklist writes IsDone on the instance it was given before raising OnTaskToggle, so the component works without a bound handler; a host that reloads the steps from storage gives it new instances.

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable identifier, unique within one checklist: it is the suffix of the step's data-testid. It never reaches a DOM id — the checkbox, description and group-body ids are built from the step's POSITION, so two ids that reduce to the same id-safe form (a.b and a-b) cannot collide. Two steps that share one Id render fine but make host tests ambiguous.

members.name: Title
members.description: The step's text — the visible label AND the accessible name of its checkbox.

members.name: Description
members.description: Optional explanation under the title, wired to the checkbox through aria-describedby.

members.name: IsDone
members.description: Whether the step is done. The checklist writes this value when the user toggles the checkbox; the done styling (strike-through) and the progress follow it.

members.name: IsOptional
members.description: Marks the step as optional: it renders a localized "Optional" badge, it still counts in the progress sentence, but it never blocks the celebration — the checklist is complete once every required step is done.

members.name: Group
members.description: Group the step belongs to. Steps that share a group render under one collapsible header with their own progress count; steps with no group render as a plain list. The value is both the group's visible title and its stable key, so casing and spacing matter.

members.name: ActionLabel
members.description: Visible text of the step's call-to-action. An action renders only when it has a target — ActionHref or OnAction; a label alone renders nothing.

members.name: ActionHref
members.description: Navigation target of the call-to-action; renders a link. Only a relative URL or the http, https or mailto scheme is rendered: javascript:, data: and vbscript: values are refused, and so is a protocol-relative //host/path (it leaves the origin). A refused value is no target at all, so the action renders nothing unless OnAction is set. OnAction wins when both are set (the handler decides what to do, including navigating).

members.name: OnAction
members.description: Handler of the call-to-action when it is a command rather than a link. The checklist awaits it, so a handler that loads data keeps its busy state. Setting it does NOT check the step — completing a step stays the user's decision.
